notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {G} or {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
